title: Define composer toolbar design tokens in src/index.css
description: Add CSS custom property definitions for the ChatAreaComposer toolbar to src/index.css so downstream tasks reference named values instead of magic numbers. Defines button size, icon size, gap rhythm, and composer-specific focus-ring color for both light and dark themes.
action: In src/index.css, inside the existing :root block add: --composer-btn-sm: 28px; --composer-btn-md: 32px; --composer-icon-sm: 14px; --composer-icon-md: 16px; --composer-toolbar-gap: 6px; --composer-focus-ring: rgba(114,64,221,0.5). These match the current h-7/h-8 Tailwind sizes to give the values a semantic name. No dark-mode overrides needed (focus-ring uses rgba which works in both).

convergence.definition_of_done: CSS custom properties for composer toolbar are defined in the :root block and can be referenced by ChatAreaComposer and ChatAreaModeControls.

files.change: Append 6 CSS custom properties after the existing semantic token declarations: --composer-btn-sm, --composer-btn-md, --composer-icon-sm, --composer-icon-md, --composer-toolbar-gap, --composer-focus-ring

implementation: Open src/index.css and locate the :root { } block (contains existing --surface-base, --primary-cta, etc. declarations).
Append the following inside :root, after the existing declarations:
--composer-btn-sm: 28px;   /* h-7 — small icon buttons in toolbar */
--composer-icon-sm: 14px;  /* icon size for small toolbar buttons */
No dark-mode block needed (rgba focus-ring and pixel sizes are theme-agnostic).

success_metrics: All existing tests pass (no CSS import breakage)

reference.pattern: Existing semantic token declarations in src/index.css :root block (--surface-base, --primary-cta, etc.)

rationale.chosen_approach: CSS custom properties in index.css (not Tailwind extend) because composer tokens are component-specific sizing constants, not reusable design system values. Tailwind config already uses CSS vars for semantic surfaces; this follows the same pattern.
decision_factors: Existing codebase uses CSS vars for semantic tokens
Component-specific values don't belong in the global Tailwind scale
rationale.tradeoffs: CSS vars not tree-shaken by Tailwind purge — acceptable since index.css is always loaded.
